id: \bThere have been some fossil sightings in here. Lenora usually comes to collect them, assuming I don't find them first.
en: \bThere have been some fossil sightings in here.  Lenora usually comes to collect them, assuming I don't find them first.
it: \bQui dentro sono stati avvistati dei fossili.  Di solito Aloé viene a raccoglierli, sempre che non li trovi prima io.

id: \bMy Pokémon need to trade to evolve. No one will do it though. They would just keep them for themselves.
en: \bMy Pokémon need to trade to evolve. No one will do it though. They would just keep them for themselves.
it: \bI miei Pokémon devono essere scambiati per evolversi. Ma nessuno lo fa. Se li terrebbero e basta.

id: \bJames: Finally. We can grab all the Pokémon we want without anyone stopping us.
en: \bJames: Finally. We can grab all the Pokémon we want without anyone stopping us.
it: \bJames: Finalmente. Possiamo prenderci tutti i Pokémon che vogliamo senza che nessuno ci fermi.

id: \bMeowth: It seems like dreams do come true.
en: \bMeowth: It seems like dreams do come true.
it: \bMeowth: Pare proprio che i sogni si avverino.

id: \rJessie: Will you two focus? This is for the boss, not some vacation. Keep searching.
en: \rJessie: Will you two focus? This is for the boss, not some vacation. Keep searching.
it: \rJessie: Volete concentrarvi, voi due? Questo è per il capo, non una vacanza. Continuate a cercare.

id: \bMeowth: Looks like our dream is on hold.
en: \bMeowth: Looks like our dream is on hold.
it: \bMeowth: Pare che il nostro sogno debba aspettare.
